svg.style: display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: visible;

path.style: fill: rgb(0, 61, 121); fill-opacity: 0; stroke: rgb(0, 70, 184); stroke-opacity: 1; stroke-width: 1; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: fill 0.4s, fill-opacity 0.4s, stroke-opacity 0.4s;

fill: rgb(197, 146, 0); fill-opacity: 0; stroke: rgb(0, 70, 184); stroke-opacity: 1; stroke-width: 1; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: fill 0.4s, fill-opacity 0.4s, stroke-opacity 0.4s;

rect.style: fill: rgb(143, 106, 0); fill-opacity: 0; stroke: rgb(0, 70, 184); stroke-opacity: 1; stroke-width: 1; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: fill 0.4s, fill-opacity 0.4s, stroke-opacity 0.4s;

circle.style: fill: rgb(217, 165, 32); fill-opacity: 0; stroke: rgb(0, 70, 184); stroke-opacity: 1; stroke-width: 1; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: fill 0.4s, fill-opacity 0.4s, stroke-opacity 0.4s;

fill: rgb(244, 211, 107); fill-opacity: 0; stroke: rgb(0, 70, 184); stroke-opacity: 1; stroke-width: 1; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: fill 0.4s, fill-opacity 0.4s, stroke-opacity 0.4s;

text.style: fill: rgb(0, 70, 184); fill-opacity: 1; stroke: rgb(0, 70, 184); stroke-opacity: 0; stroke-width: 1; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; stroke-linejoin: round; transition: fill 0.4s, fill-opacity 0.4s, stroke-opacity 0.4s; font-family: "Space Mono", monospace; font-weight: 700; font-size: 32px;
